## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1e3e11c783b150d4eb67df1f6a710e53d4818c35`
Local-runs: none
Scope: hits `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` + cited `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-governed-prose.mjs`, `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `references/cross-repo-coordination.md`, `references/execution-duties.md`, `references/seat-lifecycle.md`, `references/reading-discipline.md`, `references/contract-review.md`

### ① Derived judgments

- Diff is two governed rule-text files, +7/-7, one commit `1e3e11c7` on merge-base `59bcd223` (git diff origin/main...FETCH_HEAD). No published schema, package, script or workflow is touched; no acceptance set changes. Correct.
- `lanes/triage.md` L4 now lists triage's writes as 「标签、审计评论与关卡,⛔ 无 PR 无认领」 (was labels + audit comments). The ruled power is a close, so the charter line must gain it; 「关卡」 as close-cards is the file's existing idiom (`triage-duties.md` L53 「不因此关卡」 on base). Correct.
- `triage-duties.md` L73 encodes both ruled grants in substance: duplicate close needs target named + overlap read fresh; tracking parent `completed` needs every `Part of #n` child closed + no open work. L74 encodes signed-comment-first naming ruling + evidence, and all three ⛔ exclusions (是非关 = merits, 活认领卡 = live claim, 安全卡 = security) 「归维护者」. All present. Correct.
- Relay op: L70 names `issue_patch` and `duplicate`. `ops.mjs` L2061-2070 `issue_patch` takes optional `state`, `state_reason`; L1792 `state_reason` enum is exactly `completed`, `not_planned`, `duplicate`, `reopened` (= GitHub REST). `duplicate_of` is not a value, so the respelling is right. No per-seat op restriction in the relay (`triage` in ops.mjs/validate.mjs refers only to advisory states, L1014-1025). Correct.
- Line budget: head 20/100 lines against ceilings 20 (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L1664) and 100 (L1388); every line ≤120 bytes (longest L73 at 120; L4 118; L70 119; L74 116). The second table at L2476 is `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` (no table rows in either file; none added). No ceiling raised. Correct.
- ⛔ and ruling-line counts unchanged (lanes 7/6, duties 33/27 base = head), but by substitution: old L18's 「⛔ 优先最新不适用」 is folded into new L18 「恒最老」 and the new ⛔ is L74. Semantically intact.
- PR-body declarations re-derived: `Clause-②: no` (no published acceptance set in diff), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Fixes #30462`, `skip-changeset` label on a `.claude/**`-only diff. Correct.
- Checks on head: 23 non-skipped check-runs all `completed | success` on re-poll, including Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Check Changeset; nothing red or pending.

### ② Semver level

None. No package touched, no changeset owed; `skip-changeset` is consistent with the diff and with dispatch-30462.md L3.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); no off-relay login to name.

- Dev flag 1 (L70 dropped 「首触定级即并」, `duplicate_of` → `duplicate`): not wider than the ruling. Card #30462 body explicitly wants "a duplicate a lane names" (post first-touch) closable; the ruling carries no first-touch limit. Bounds remain: L71 「在飞(assignee/open PR)永不并」, L72 execution seats flag via `pm:retriage` and do not merge, L74 live-claim exclusion. The respelling matches `ops.mjs` L1792. Answered, accepted.
- Dev flag 2 (⛔ scoped to 「此权」): existing first-touch `not_planned` closes are sanctioned on their own text: `triage-duties.md` L59-61 「无则关 = 首触即关 not_planned」, L77-78, `SKILL.md` L114 「首触即关」, `seat-lifecycle.md` L48. 「此权」 directly follows the L73 definition, so the scope is unambiguous. The pre-existing tension between L60/L77 and the human floor L86 「卡的命运(关 not planned…)」 is on base, not introduced here. Answered, accepted. Minor: 「是非关」 is terse; the PR body glosses it; no room on L74 to spell it longer without paying bytes elsewhere.
- Dev flag 3 (「merged PR 引用的卡不动」 unchanged): conflicts, see must-fix 1 in ④. The dev's reading "stricter than the ruling, not widened" understates it: it blocks the ruling's own exemplar.
- Dev flag 4 (`check-half-states.mjs` L17381 quotes old wording): no checker or test greps the changed sentences. L36071 asserts `FULL67.includes('清不空的那一刻起改最老优先')`, but `FULL67` is `q67(...)` (L36059), the script's own rendered clause whose literal lives at L18916; it never reads the rule file. The only reader of `triage-duties.md` that asserts content is `label-write.mjs` L1803-1804, pinning the span `` `RECLAIM_AFTER_HOURS = 12` ``, still present at head L81 unchanged. `check-governed-prose.mjs` pins governed-glob enumerations only (header L5-7); `check-skill-id-lint` is issue numbers (none added). Searched scripts/, .github/, .claude/, AGENTS.md for 「首触定级即并」「半状态治愈积压」「析取 ①/②/④」「只写标签与审计评论」「由维护者一句召唤」「优先最新不适用」: zero hits outside the two files. The now-non-verbatim quotes at `check-half-states.mjs` L17381-17382, L17434, L18916 are comments/strings out of this card's surface. Answered, accepted; see should-fix 1.
- Deviations in os-dev-report 6673057141 (AGENTS.md partial read, hook-refused `Fixes` trailer amended before push): no effect on the diff.
- `open_questions`: none.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`: L4 holds against the acceptance scenario (triage closes two card classes) and the rest of the charter; consistent with `execution-duties.md` L59 「已修交分诊或维护者关,⛔ 不自关」 and `reading-discipline.md` L30 「判重仍归分诊…定关哪个」, which already assume triage closes. No sibling reference says triage never closes. Stands.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`: L70, L73, L74 encode the ruling and its three exclusions faithfully; the two new lines sit before L79 so 「例外:下三行」 on L79 still points at L80-82 (verified at head). L13-14 and L18 rewrites preserve labels, the ~2-minute `updated_at` cut, and the oldest-first/P0-first ordering.

must-fix 1: L79 「⛔ 带 `pm:dispatched`/assignee/open 或 merged PR 引用的卡不动;例外:下三行、main-red 锚卡首触」 is a file-wide ⛔ with an explicit exception list that does not include L73. A tracking parent whose children were delivered by PRs is, in the normal case, cross-referenced by those merged PRs: the ruling's own exemplar #29465 (close comment 6670579539, `state_reason: completed`) is cross-referenced by seven merged PRs (29590, 29598, 29993, 29998, 30012, 30030, 30139 per its timeline). Read as written, L79 forbids the exact close the maintainer ruled and the card was filed to unblock ("waited one to ten days"), and the rule text itself does not say it is narrower than the ruling; only the PR body does. A ⛔ line contradicting a power line in governed text is not acceptable conservatism: the triage seat must either treat the power as a dead letter or disregard a ⛔. Fix inside the file surface and under the caps, e.g. L79 → 「- ⛔ 带 `pm:dispatched`/assignee/open 或 merged PR 引用的卡不动;例外:上两行、下三行、锚卡首触。」 (119 bytes; 「锚卡」 is defined as the main-red anchor at L22-26), or any equivalent that names L73-74 as an exception. Line count stays 100.

should-fix 1: file a follow-up for `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L17381-17382, L17434, L18916 (and the self-assert at L36071) so the quoted ordering sentence matches new L18, out of this card's surface.

should-fix 2: `SKILL.md` L133 「重复 ⇒ `duplicate` + `duplicate_of`」 and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L31 still use the `duplicate_of` token; L70 no longer does. Not a contradiction (`duplicate` is the state_reason, the target named per L73 is the `duplicate_of` content, as the worked example 6658063257 "Duplicate of #30075" shows), but the token no longer cross-greps. `SKILL.md` is held by #30273; note it there.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `51d3c13761b82cd9b9359469786f6fba8db17ef5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: delta `1e3e11c7..51d3c137` (hits `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` L79 only) + my earlier full record 6673206709 on head `1e3e11c7`; cited `references/lanes/triage.md`, `references/platform-readings.md`, `references/rest-channel.md`, `references/filing-gate.md`, `references/dispatch-runbook.md`

### ① Derived judgments

- Delta is one commit `51d3c137` whose parent is `1e3e11c7` (git rev-parse `51d3c137^`), one file, +1/-1: `triage-duties.md` L79 only. Nothing else changed; the dev's description is exact.
- New L79: 「⛔ 带 `pm:dispatched`/assignee/open 或 merged PR 引用的卡不动;例外:关卡行、下三行、锚卡首触。」 = 119 bytes (cap 120). File is 100 lines (ceiling 100, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L1388); no line over 120 bytes. No ceiling raised.
- The change answers must-fix 1 of record 6673206709: the L73-74 close power is now named as an exception to the hands-off ⛔, so the ruling's exemplar (#29465, cross-referenced by seven merged PRs) is no longer forbidden by the rule text. 「main-red 锚卡首触」 → 「锚卡首触」 loses nothing: 锚卡 is defined as the main-red anchor at L22-26 (L23 「main-red 锚卡」, L24 「锚卡关闭」).
- 「关卡行」 resolution: in the file at head the token 「关卡」 occurs at L53 (「⛔ …不因此关卡」, a prohibition inside the `reach:` rule), L74 (「关卡先贴签名评论…此权」, the only line that opens with 关卡) and L79 itself. L77-78 (first-touch / stale-premise `not planned` closes) say 「关闭」/「关 not planned」, not 「关卡」. As an exception to a hands-off line, L53 cannot be meant (it grants nothing), so 「关卡行」 resolves to the line opening with 关卡, L74, whose 「此权」 binds it to L73's conditions. Unambiguous enough for a seat reading the file; `lanes/triage.md` L4 「只写标签、审计评论与关卡」 uses the same close-cards sense, as do `platform-readings.md` L428/437, `rest-channel.md` L45, `filing-gate.md` L27 and `dispatch-runbook.md` L154 on main, so no competing meaning (checkpoint/level) exists in this skill.
- PR-body declarations unchanged and still correct: `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Fixes #30462`, `skip-changeset`; labels documentation / size/s / skip-changeset; still draft.
- Check-runs on `51d3c137` at second poll: 11 non-skipped `completed | success` (Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Type Check · workspace, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Auto Label, filter); 9 still `in_progress` (Lint · CI, release & engine gates; Lint · ESLint; Lint · PM dispatch-gates; Lint · docs & code guards; Lint · repo & tooling gates; Lint · scoped · query-options erasure; Type Check · consumer / debt ledger / source gates). None red. The same families were all green on `1e3e11c7`, and the delta is one prose line inside the same two-file surface. Landing still requires the pending runs to finish green (contract-review.md L51).

### ② Semver level

None, unchanged from 6673206709: `.claude/**` only, no changeset owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author `user.login` = `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay login to name.

- Dev's choice of 「关卡行」 over 「上两行」: accepted. L73-74 are not adjacent to L79 (L75-78 sit between), so a positional reference would have been wrong; a token reference is the right form and the token resolves uniquely (see ①). The only conceivable misread, taking 「关卡行」 as every line that closes a card including L77-78, is not supported by the text: those lines never use 关卡, and L79 was precisely their guard, so reading them in would nullify the ⛔ it sits on. Not a flag.
- All other flags from 6673206709 stand answered; no new deviations reported, no `open_questions`.

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md`: L79 now names three exceptions to the hands-off ⛔ (the close power at L73-74, the in-flight liveness rows L80-82, the main-red anchor first-touch at L22-23), which is the full set of triage actions that legitimately touch an in-flight or merged-PR-referenced card. Scope of the exception is bounded by L73-74's own limits (target named + overlap read fresh; all `Part of #n` children closed + no open work; signed comment first; ⛔ merits / live claim / security stay with the maintainer), so the hands-off line is pierced only for what the maintainer ruled. The 「例外:下三行」 pointer still lands on L80-82. Stands.

should-fix 1 (carried from 6673206709, unchanged): follow-up card for `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` L17381-17382, L17434, L18916, L36071 so the quoted ordering sentence matches new L18; out of surface.

should-fix 2 (carried, unchanged): `SKILL.md` L133 and `cross-repo-coordination.md` L31 still spell `duplicate_of`; note it on #30273.

No must-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:分诊章程加上你裁的关卡权:分诊可把重复卡关为 `duplicate`(点名目标卡、重叠刚读过),可把所有 `Part of #n` 子卡都已关、自身无未完工作的追踪父卡关为 `completed`;关之前先贴签名评论,写明裁决与证据。按是非关卡、关有活认领的卡、关安全卡仍归你。经中继 `issue_patch`(state + state_reason)执行,不改脚本。
- 为什么改:你在分诊会话说「同意，需要的话立skills卡」;原章程只许写标签和审计评论,重复卡和已完成的父卡要等你手关,等了 1 到 10 天。
- 风险与回滚:2 个 `.claude/**` 文件各 +/− 等行,行数上限未动;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`references/triage-duties.md` 第 73–74 行和第 79 行(“不动”规则的例外清单已把关卡行列入)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 通过,两个文件行数与 main 相同(20/100)。
- 需要你做的:无。`.claude/**` 为 Tier S,复核 FAIL 一次(6673206709,L79 的 ⛔ 会挡住新权限),修复后 delta 复核 PASS(6673388418),席位直接入自动合并。
- 席位意见:可合。两条可选建议(`check-half-states.mjs` 注释仍引旧措辞;SKILL.md 与跨仓文件仍写 `duplicate_of`)留作后续,不阻塞。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · head 51d3c13761b82cd9b9359469786f6fba8db17ef5

- **形态**:2 文件,`.claude/**` only(Tier S),`skip-changeset`,`Fixes #30462`,作者 `objectstack-fleet[bot]`。
- **契约**:Clause-② no,Metadata-protocol none,与认领 6672679484 一致。
- **前提实测**:dev 报告 6673057141;中继 `issue_patch` 的 `state_reason` 枚举对 `ops.mjs` 核过(复核记录 ①)。
- **门禁 check-runs**:head 上 44 个,23 success,21 skipped,0 红。
- **接受的偏差**:L70 去掉“首触定级即并”(裁决本无首触限制,其余边界仍在);⛔ 限定“此权”,原有首触 not_planned 关卡各有出处。
- **范围外去向**:`check-half-states.mjs` 注释措辞由席位立后续卡。
- **落地条款**:Tier S,席位经中继 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`;合并后核 #30462 已关、摘 `pm:dispatched`,并告知分诊席。
